```{r}
video_id   <- "2hyoyxdTfl4"
langue_sub <- "fr"
ytdlp      <- "python -m yt_dlp"   # si ca echoue, mets "py -m yt_dlp"
max_com    <- 1000    
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(syuzhet)
library(tidytext)
```

```{r}
url <- paste0("https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=", video_id)
```

```{r}
system(paste0(ytdlp, ' --list-subs "', url, '"'))

system(paste0(
  ytdlp, ' --skip-download --write-comments ',
  '--extractor-args "youtube:max_comments=', max_com, '" ',
  '--write-auto-subs --write-subs --sub-langs "', langue_sub, '.*" ',
  '--sub-format vtt -o "video" "', url, '"'
))
```

```{r}
if (!file.exists("video.info.json")) stop("video.info.json introuvable : le telechargement a echoue.")

info <- fromJSON("video.info.json")
if (is.null(info$comments)) stop("Aucun commentaire recupere (commentaires desactives ou blocage YouTube).")

df_com <- tibble(texte = info$comments$text)
cat("Nombre de commentaires recuperes :", nrow(df_com), "\n")

```

```{r}
fichier_vtt <- list.files(pattern = "^video.*\\.vtt$")[1]
if (is.na(fichier_vtt)) stop("Aucun sous-titre telecharge : regarde la liste affichee par --list-subs ou change de video.")
cat("Fichier de sous-titres :", fichier_vtt, "\n")

lignes <- readLines(fichier_vtt, encoding = "UTF-8")

texte_sub <- lignes |>
  str_subset("-->", negate = TRUE) |>
  str_remove_all("<[^>]+>") |>
  str_squish()

texte_sub <- texte_sub[texte_sub != "" &
                       !str_detect(texte_sub, "^(WEBVTT|Kind:|Language:)")]
```

```{r}
texte_sub <- texte_sub[c(TRUE, texte_sub[-1] != texte_sub[-length(texte_sub)])]

```

```{r}
df_sub <- tibble(texte = texte_sub) |>
  mutate(bloc = (row_number() - 1) %/% 8) |>
  group_by(bloc) |>
  summarise(texte = paste(texte, collapse = " "), .groups = "drop") |>
  select(texte)
```

```{r}
nettoyer <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_remove_all("http\\S+") |>
    str_replace_all("[^\\p{L}\\s]", " ") |>
    str_squish()
}

df_all <- bind_rows(
  df_sub |> mutate(source = "Sous-titres"),
  df_com |> mutate(source = "Commentaires")
) |>
  mutate(texte_clean = nettoyer(texte)) |>
  filter(texte_clean != "")
```

```{r}
df_all <- df_all |>
  mutate(
    score = get_sentiment(texte_clean, method = "nrc", lang = "french"),
    avis  = case_when(score > 0 ~ "positif",
                      score < 0 ~ "négatif",
                      TRUE      ~ "neutre")
  )
```

```{r}
resultats <- df_all |>
  count(source, avis) |>
  group_by(source) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
print(resultats)
```

```{r}
print(df_all |> group_by(source) |> summarise(score_moyen = mean(score)))
```

```{r}
g1 <- ggplot(resultats, aes(avis, pct, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Sentiment : discours vs public",
       x = NULL, y = "% des textes", fill = "Source") +
  theme_minimal()
print(g1)
```

```{r}
mots <- df_all |>
  unnest_tokens(mot, texte_clean) |>
  filter(!mot %in% stopwords::stopwords("fr"), nchar(mot) > 2)

g2 <- mots |>
  count(source, mot, sort = TRUE) |>
  group_by(source) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(reorder_within(mot, n, source), n, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~source, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Mots les plus fréquents", x = NULL, y = "Fréquence") +
  theme_minimal()
print(g2)
```

```{r}
df_all |>
  group_by(source) |>
  slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  select(source, texte, score, avis) |>
  print(n = 20)

write_csv(df_all, "resultats_sentiment.csv")
cat("Termine. Resultats sauvegardes dans resultats_sentiment.csv\n")

```
